estimator: population EER under the fitted bivariate Gaussian random-effects model: bona fide N(mu, sd_grp (+) sd_res), spoof N(mu, sd_spk (+) sd_att (+) sd_res); closed form, no simulation
why: the paper cites the fitted population EERs to justify certifying coverage at organizer-era rates and not in the low-EER regime

summary.note: the organizer-era fit lands within a factor of 1.3 of the real rates while the low-EER fit is out by factors of ~7 and ~30, which is why the coverage check is certified in the former regime. Neither fit reproduces the GAP: organizer-era fitted delta 4.679 against a real 1.094. Coverage is therefore assessed against the model's own population Delta-EER (Monte Carlo), never against the real one.
